name: tally-extension
description: Easily count the number of words, characters, and paragraphs on any site.

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:copy && bun run build:js && bun run build:css && bun run build:zip
scripts.build:copy: mkdir -p build && cp -R README.md LICENSE src/manifest.json src/assets build/
scripts.build:js: bun build src/background.ts src/content.ts --outdir build --target browser --format iife
scripts.build:zip: cd build && bestzip tally-word-counter.zip README.md LICENSE manifest.json assets background.js content.js style.css
